product_metadata.title: MIUCO Blackout Curtains Room Darkening Curtains Textured Grommet Panels for Living Room 2 Panels 52x84 Inch Long Sage
features: STRUCTURE - Includes 2 panels, each 52 inch wide by 84 inch long. 8 metal grommets per panel with 1.6 inch inner diameter fit up to a 1.5" rod.

NEW BLACKOUT TECHNOLOGY - Innovative triple-weave construction helps block up to 90% Sunlight (darker colors have a better effect). Perfect for napping children, day sleepers, shift workers. Also helps reduce noise.

STYLISH - Miuco blackout curtains offer a luxurious textured look and feel. Not like a bland solid color, it's stylish and functional, fit in perfect with any decor for living room, bedroom, kitchen or office.

ENERGY EFFICIENT - Helps to keep the heat in the room during the winter, and keep cool during the summer. Saves on home heating and cooling costs. Miuco blackout curtains work better if paired with Miuco sheer curtains.
EASY CARE - Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, do not bleach, tumble dry low, wrinkles will be disappeared after hanging for a few weeks, or warm iron.
description: Tired of not sleeping after shift work? Have horrible napping time with your baby and kids? Hate bright sunlight wake your body up through south-facing windows?
Miuco textured weaved blackout curtains are the perfect solution, as they can be set up to:
Innovative triple-weave construction helps block up to 90% sunlight. 100% physical blackout, zero chemical backing, it's good to your health.

Miuco blackout curtains offer a luxurious textured weaved look and feel. Not like a bland solid color, it's stylish and functional, fit in perfect with any decor for living room, bedroom, kitchen or office.
Your family and friends can enjoy movie nights or sports game without worrying about outside light and noise.
Densely woven fabric acts as an additional sound barrier. It reduces outside noises and create a quiet and peaceful environment.
With Miuco creative designed weighted hem in the both bottoms, make the curtains hangs much straight and well.
Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, do not bleach, tumble dry low, wrinkles will be disappeared after hanging for a few weeks, or warm iron.
Darker colors have a better blackout effect.
